notes.title: Plushie update (and some news)!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It's taken a bit of time, but the Somier plush is finally created! I admit, we didn't think the process was going to be quite as lengthy as it was, but we're very happy with the result!

The next step will be starting the Makeship campaign. We'll keep everyone informed when it goes live.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30514749/1d468a8dd0659ff26a5be5cc9b2dec17226505c4.png[/img]

He's looking pretty cute, with a removable backpack, potions and various knickknacks. We were sent the prototype, and it feels nice, soft and sturdy. 

We'll be ordering a few ourselves to decorate our office when the time comes. It'll go well with our giant [i]Kyrie [/i]banner and [i]The Maw Energy Drinks (tm?)[/i] that we keep around.

Thanks again to everyone that took the time to vote for their favorite plush idea before! And thanks for your patience on this!

[h1]New Project:[/h1]
For anyone looking for news on our new project, it's still sparse on that front. Progress has been going well, but we're not quite ready for a full showcase yet. There are still too many placeholders and as they say: [i]you never get a second chance at a first impression[/i]. So, we want to make sure to impress when we start showing the game off!

Still, here's a quick screenshot to get an idea of how things are shaping up:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30514749/ea8959524ec6766ceb6afa2a9fd753c4f037fa91.png[/img]
Still a work in progress of course, but this showcases some of the systems the game has, such as interactable elements that work together to create various effects (explosions, electrocutions, difficult terrain, etc). Here we see the liquid elements, namely water and blood (there's also an ice patch on there, although those will only be in winter maps). 

Water can put out fires and transfer electric attacks to people standing in it, for example. The other elements are currently functional, but lack proper visuals, so we can't showcase those interactions just yet. The explosive stuff is pretty funny though, as explosions can be chained if they're close enough, and it can pack quite a punch if a target is in the middle of several at once!

[b]Where we're headed:[/b]
We're not a 100% sure about how we'll handle the overall process yet, with respect to [i]Kickstarter[/i], [i]Beta[/i], [i]Early Access[/i] and [i]Release[/i], but the current goal is to get things visually presentable as a first step, to keep our options open.

From there, we want to create our new [i]Steam page[/i] as early as possible, so we can keep in touch with the community in a dedicated space (rather that use [i]Fell Seal[/i]'s space). Afterwards, we're currently leaning towards a [i]Kickstarter[/i] + [i]Early Access[/i] cycle again. We were very happy with the amount of visibility and feedback we were able to get that way for [i]Fell Seal[/i] (again, a big thank you to everyone for that!). We think the EA was especially pivotal in getting the game out the door with a solid state of balance and boasting QoL features that the community actually cared for.

So, that's where we're at for now!

notes.title: Fell Seal: Arbiter's Mark update 1.6.0 is out!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30514749/a7af958ae81cb39363f3f1346f1d73de7e8bf3a6.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

As promised, here's the [b]Knifer and Draekon[/b] update for [i]Missions and Monsters[/i]!

The update adds these 2 new monsters:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30514749/82d92f9fb0a7cebb9078167c3ff842625a7f16b4.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30514749/8d80bb0b5456dd0931a0ca2bf752afca8a966b93.gif[/img]

They come with 2 new missions at the guild, which will each open a Hunt featuring a unique version of one of the new monsters.

Both monsters can be tamed and their essence can be harvested by a certain Bzil unit.
They have some pretty unique abilities, including what we would consider a "signature move" for each one of them. Give them a look! They'll be an interesting addition to your arsenal, opening up new strategies for creative players!

Otherwise, the build has some bug fixes as well. As usual, the full patch notes are at the end of the post.

To celebrate this occasion we have prepared a Steam Daily Deal - starting today at 19:00 CEST, for next 48 hours, you can get[b] Fell Seal: Arbiter's Mark with a 67% discount[/b] and the [b]Missions and Monsters DLC with 50% discount![/b] If you haven't grabbed the base game or the DLC yet, now is the right time to remedy that.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/15253/Fell_Seal_Arbiters_Mark__Missions_and_Monsters_DLC/

[h1]What's next for 6 Eyes Studio:[/h1]
Unless further balance tweaks and bug fixes are needed, this is the last major update planned for Fell Seal. We'll be focusing solely on our next project from now on.

This whole adventure has been an awesome experience for us, and we hope it's been for the fans as well!
Again, we've been humbled by the tremendous support from the Steam community and on our Discord. We couldn't have done it without you guys!

Throughout the course of the development, we've done our best to balance community feedback with "what can realistically be done with our effective production power"; all while not compromising our vision. On the whole, we'd claim some level of success in that respect, but at the same time, we know there's plenty of areas that can be improved upon for our future projects. As such, we're hoping everyone will keep walking this path with us and providing us with their feedback, comments and support on our future projects!

As for specifics on the next game, we can't announce too many details yet, but it will be a strategy RPG with turn-based combat and more of a pixelart visual style, rather than the mix of illustrations/pixelart of [i]Fell Seal[/i]. There'll be a bit less emphasis on battles than [i]Fell Seal[/i] and more "outside of combat" elements, such as quests, exploring and trading.

On the technical side, we've been busy updating our engines for a while now, and here's what you can expect for our next game:[list]
[*][b]Increased Modding support, including:[/b]
[list][*]Adding your own sprites, music and sound effects to the game.
[*]Some tools to help with the above.
[*]Steam Workshop support.
[*]Built-in support for using multiple mods at once (eg. having 2 different mods that add new classes to the game, without having to manually merge their files).
[*]Simplified system to add languages.[/list]
[*][b]Interface:[/b] An interface primarily designed around mouse and Keyboard, rather than a gamepad (we will still retain full gamepad support though).
[*][b]Saving:[/b] We'll be making sure not to save in a weird location on Mac and Linux (sorry about that guys!).
[*][b]Sound:[/b] We redid a lot of the inner working of our sound engine and it should deliver a better experience, with smoother transitions and much smoother "volume ducking" if we end up going that route.
[*][b]Performance:[/b] This one probably won't exactly be a game-changer for most people, but we've made some updates to our system and it's using less memory and loading things faster in general. Not that [i]Fell Seal[/i] actually had any loading times before, but still...
[/list]
We'll be releasing more details and some screenshots as soon as we have something presentable!
In the meantime, get on our mailing list (from [url=https://www.fellseal.com]https://www.fellseal.com[/url]) if you want to make sure not to miss any of the upcoming details. Also, you can follow us on Steam, as we'll have some announcements when the store page is ready for the next project!


[h1]A question for everyone:[/h1]
Did you guys enjoy the [b]devlog[/b] series we had for [i]Missions and Monsters[/i]? Would something like that for our next game be of interest to you?

We plan on showing you a variety of things throughout production. Do you want to hear more about the lore and story? See images of characters, monsters, and environments? Learn more about the technical processes behind the scene? Understand how the game's mechanics will function? Let us know in the comments!


[h1]In other news...[/h1]
Today 1C Entertainment is also publishing a brand new turn-based, story-driven RPG adventure called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1543430/Terrain_of_Magical_Expertise/]Terrain of Magical Expertise[/url]. The game is inspired by a popular animated webseries (but not to worry, you will enjoy playing it even if you have never watched it!) and features a full cast of voice actors, including talents from some of your favorite video games, YouTube channels, anime and cartoons, as well as charming animations and a huge world to explore

[b]Get Terrain of Magical Expertise right now with a 15% launch discount for the first week:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1543430/Terrain_of_Magical_Expertise/

While we're on the topic of monsters, our friends over at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/814370/Monster_Sanctuary/]Monster Sanctuary[/url] are preparing a juicy DLC of their own called [i]Forgotten World[/i]. They're holding a community contest to design a monster which could end up in-game, as part of it. You can check it out right here:
[url=https://twitter.com/moi_rai_/status/1435267531099492357]https://twitter.com/moi_rai_/status/1435267531099492357[/url]

Also, if you haven't checked out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/814370/Monster_Sanctuary/]Monster Sanctuary[/url] on Steam yet, you probably should: it's a slick game :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/814370/Monster_Sanctuary/

[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]
[u]09/09/2021 - Version 1.6.0[/u]
[h1]New Content:[/h1][list]
[*][b]Draekon/Knifer:[/b] Adding 2 new monsters to the content of Missions and Monsters. The Draekon and Knifer. They have their own sprites, abilities, portraits, Bzil versions, etc.
[*][b]Missions:[/b] Adding 2 new missions tied to the Draekon and Knifer monsters.
[*][b]Hunts:[/b] Adding 2 new hunts featuring unique versions of the Draekon and Knifer monsters.

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1][list]
[*][b]Hellhunds:[/b] Could use the wrong graphic for a specific variant. Fixed.
[*][b]Eruptor:[/b] There was an issue where the buff wouldn't reset correctly under certain circumstances. Fixed.
[*][b]Change Appearance:[/b] The option at the guild would be unavailable if the player had no human recruits, even if they had monster recruits. Fixed.
[*][b]Buffs at the start of the turn:[/b] Buffs granted by equipment at the start of the turn wouldn't show on the information panel until it was refreshed (even though they would be correctly enabled). Fixed.
[*][b]Level Up:[/b] When gaining a level in combat, the current HP wouldn't be increased by the amount gained to max HP, which would make certain passives tied to "having full HP" less attractive. Changed things so the current HP is increased by the same amount as HP gained for the level.
[*][b]Guttersnipe:[/b] Pet was incorrectly increasing bleed damage. Fixed. Also, when both Guttersnipe and Polliwog were out, only Guttersnipe would apply its debuff at the end of the turn on adjacent targets. Fixed.
[*][b]Autosave:[/b] The autosave before battle could fail to save new consumables that were crafted during battle setup, while still using the ingredients. Fixed.
[*][b]Maps:[/b] Fixing a few layering issues in various maps.
[*][b]Taming:[/b] If the target was asleep, the sleep effect could remain visible after taming them. Fixed.
[*][b]Mouse Cursor:[/b] The cursor could vanish on the worldmap under certain circumstances that might leave it invisible in the troops menu as well. Fixed.
[*][b]Class change:[/b] The mouse would behave oddly in this screen while in 4k mode (or certain other resolutions). Fixed.
[*][b]Scrollers:[/b] The scroll bar would behave oddly in 4k when dragging the scroll button. Fixed.
[*][b]Misc:[/b] Fixing small miscellaneous issues.
[/list]
[h1]Modding:[/h1][list]
[*][b]Counters:[/b] The "kOffensiveCounterWithBuff" counter type wasn't fully functional before. It works like kOffensiveCounterWithDebuff, except it adds a buff on the user rather than a debuff on the attacker.
[*][b]Telekinesis:[/b] The passive will now be useable by human classes as well (it was only working on monster units before).
[/list]

notes.title: Update incoming soon!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We know it's been a while since we put some news up! I don' think we were quite prepared for just how much work our team's latest addition would create for us...

But, we've been back in business for some weeks now, and I'm happy to report we're just about done with the big update for [i]Missions and Monsters[/i] that we talked about a while ago!

You should expect the [b]update to go live in about 2 weeks[/b], for all platforms and all consoles. We'll save the exact patch notes for the actual release, but in a nutshell, it contains several bug fixes for the whole game and [b]2 new monsters[/b] for the DLC [i]Missions and Monsters[/i].

Those monsters can be fought against, tamed, and have their Bzil counterparts.
It's been a while, so let me refresh everyone's memory with their looks:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30514749/2116f62ac11bdbea5b472ec01b73d870f67b2ac0.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30514749/273c2550a7351c1e2fccdef7162de77af90c1ea9.gif[/img]


[h1]It's been 3 years![/h1]
Also, it's been roughly 3 years since our Early Access launched on Steam. Time sure flies by!
We wanted to take this opportunity to mention again how [b]grateful we are for the incredible community support[/b] we've received throughout [i]Fell Seal[/i]'s lifetime and, especially, during our Early Access. 

The feedback has been invaluable and has helped us greatly in getting [i]Fell Seal[/i] where it's at today! Of course, not all interesting ideas could be added to [i]Fell Seal[/i], but we've been taking notes, and our next project will be that much better for it!

On that front, we're almost done with the initial design phase of our next game, and we'll be starting asset production soon. Sadly, we don't have any screenshots to share yet (unless you find spreadsheets exciting), but we'll get there soon enough!

On that note, if you want to make sure you don't miss out on any news and screenshots of our next project, you should head to our website [url=https://www.fellseal.com/]https://www.fellseal.com/[/url] and register for our newsletter.

And once again, thanks a ton for the awesome support!

notes.title: Update 1.4.1 is live.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We had a lot of feedback after our last update, about our new UI to show quickly when units have enough AP to master their class, and we made some tweaks to make the feature even better.

Now, the mastery star will be shown as well as the AP-arrow icon, so the player can see all the information at once. Also, the star will bounce up and down if there's new AP to master a class, but it's not yet mastered and won't bounce if the class is already mastered. We also made some visual adjustment to pretty things up.

Here's the full change list:

[u]07/15/2020 - Version 1.4.1[/u]
[h1]UI:[/h1][list]
[*][b]Troops Menu:[/b] The star that shows a character has learned all the abilities for their current class will now be shown next to the AP Arrow, rather than replace it, so more information is conveyed. Also, it will bounce if the character "has enough AP to master the class but hasn't learned it all yet" versus not bounce if the class is already mastered.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1][list]
[*][b]Victory Dance:[/b] Could still apply deep wounds or venom to allies under certain circumstances. Fixed.
[*][b]Troops Menu:[/b] Fixing some issues where the AP arrow/mastery icon in the main troops menu would disappear after changing class on a unit, until the menu was reopened.
[*][b]Deployment:[/b] For monsters using "default variant visuals", when changing their class during deployment, their sprite wouldn't update on the map if they were already deployed. Fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.4.0 is live
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We have another update today. Mostly bug fixes, but we've also been listening to feedback on the forums and added some UI changes to help people deal with their increased roster size.

From the troops menu, you'll now see a star on units that have mastered their current main class, or have enough AP to master it. From the Ability learn menu, there'll be a new option to "learn all" abilities if there's enough AP to do so. This should help players manage their troops easier and faster.

We're still gathering feedback on that front so feel free to let us know your suggestions on the forums.

Thanks!

[u]07/12/2020 - Version 1.4.0[/u]
[h1]UI:[/h1][list]
[*][b]Troops Menu:[/b] Now showing a * icon for a unit (instead of the arrow-up icon) if they have mastered their main class, or have enough AP to master it.
[*][b]Learn Ability Menu:[/b] Adding a new button to instantly learn all the skills on the page if there is enough AP to do so. A tutorial about this new feature will be shown the first time the player could use the new button.
[/list]

[h1]Balance:[/h1][list]
[*][b]Maximum Units:[/b] Increasing the default amount of maximum units from 54 to 66.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1][list]
[*][b]Aegis Hide:[/b] Was incorrectly greatly reducing damage from back attacks as well as front/side attacks. Fixed.
[*][b]Heel!:[/b] Would still work on targets market as "non-displaceable". Now it'll show 0% chance to work if the target is immune and it won't displace them.
[*][b]Oldebzar:[/b] Some water tiles had incorrect height information. Fixed.
[*][b]Arena:[/b] One enemy had 2 body armors equipped in one of the bouts. Fixed!
[*][b]Text:[/b] There were various small errors in non-english text and UI. Fixed all we found.
[*][b]Equilibrium:[/b] Dispelling effects would not correctly trigger Equilibrium in all cases. Fixed. Also, Equilibrium will be applied after regular damage, so if the target dies from the attack, Equilibrium will not be applied.
[*][b]Dumadi Depths and Three Sisters Hunt:[/b] Fixing level range if player accesses it as early as possible in the story.
[*][b]Helhunds:[/b] Fixing some visual inconsistencies when using multiple variants (some issues remain on that front that require some asset updates and will take a little longer to get fixed).
[*][b]Monsters Customizations:[/b] Some of the customizations were not layering in the correct order. Fixed many of them, although we could have missed some (so many permutations, it's hard to check it all). Let us know if you find anything weird, thanks!

[/list]

[h1]Modding:[/h1][list]
[*][b]Abilities.txt:[/b] Adding the "kRes" value to the list of values for DmgSource in abilities. This functions like kDef that was already there but will use the unit's RES value as the source stat for the power of the ability.
[*][b]Monster Portraits:[/b] There was still an issue with custom monster portraits where they would stop loading after reloading a save file. Fixed.
[/list]

Hello everyone :)

This is a very small update for PC only again.

We mistakenly turned off error logging when parsing mod files in the previous build. This update restores that so modders have better feedback on issues. notes.notes:
Hello,

I'm posting the notes about this update for consistency, but it should not matter to 99% of players. This is to add a new option to the GameConfig.txt to help a few specific players that seem to be unable to load textures correctly with the latest builds.

notes.title: New 64bits version
notes.notes:
This is the last announcement in quick succession hopefully!

We just split the Steam Windows build into a 32 bits version and a 64 bits version.

Steam should automatically detect the correct one for you (the 64bits version for about 99.5% of the players in our case, haha) and start using that one. The download won't be anything special as it's just the main executable getting changed, more or less, so no worries on everyone's bandwidth!

This is mainly in preparation for the [i]Missions and Monsters[/i] expansion, as it uses a bit more memory. Technically, not enough to require a 64 bits, but we'd rather play it safe and there's very little to lose by providing the 64 bits version of the game anyways.

Let us know if you run into any issues.

Thanks!

notes.title: Update 1.2.0 - Patch Notes 2/2
notes.notes:
This is the rest of the patch notes for Update 1.2.0, since they were too big to fit in a single update.

[h1]Patch Notes (2/2):[/h1]
[u]05/06/2020 - Version 1.2.0[/u]
[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]4_3[/b] Fixing small inconsistencies in the Help screen and Try and Buy screens while using a 4:3 aspect ratio.
[*][b]Pulsar Generator:[/b] Spell could change the facing of the target to a different facing than the target had at the start of the spell. Fixed.
[*][b]New Game Plus:[/b] A certain secret character wouldn't retain his AP correctly in a New Game Plus. Fixed.
[*][b]Mouse:[/b] Using the mouse wheel, it was possible to enable the "Dismiss" command on Story characters in the Troops menu (and also during battles). Fixed.
[*][b]Swarm Strike:[/b] There was a visual glitch where "helpers" that are sleeping would remain upright (and still sleeping) at the end of the Swarm Strike animation. We don't want to change the functionality or complexify the ability, so it will keep working correctly even if teammates are sleeping, but their frames will reset to "sleeping" correctly at the end of the animation.
[*][b]Large Units:[/b] Cleaning up the way distance is calculated to/from larger units so it always uses the closest distance. This should make abilities that rely on distance (or the distance of weapons) always function correctly with larger units.
[*][b]New Recruits:[/b] Fixing a bug where under certain circumstances, new recruits from an advanced class would still lose access to that class after switching them out (even though we changed that behavior in a prior update).
[*][b]AI:[/b] The AI could have odd movements under certain circumstances. Fixed.
[*][b]Misc:[/b] Reducing memory usage a tiny bit in battles and menus.
[*][b]Name Change:[/b] When changing the name of a recruit and then canceling changes, the old name wouldn't be restored.
[*][b]AI:[/b] AI could make odd decisions when it came to One for all, selecting it when it shouldn't or not selecting it when it should. Fixed.
[*][b]Niwot:[/b] Enemy had idle stance running too quickly. Fixed.
[*][b]Random Drops:[/b] There was an issue with the way the map rewards were being generated and it could often result in wrong odds for most item, the longer the player went without restarting the game. It also resulted in a lot more Godwood drops late game than was intended.
[*][b]Mystic Shield:[/b] Fixing an issue where Mystic Shield would absorb damage as MP if the character would heal from the damage due to high elemental resistances.
[*][b]Mystic Shield:[/b] Fixing an issue where the MP damage wouldn't be shown correctly when punting a target with Mystic Shield if there was no bonus damage.
[*][b]Sacrifice Abilities:[/b] Those abilities could have inconsistent behavior with One for All, Protect and other more complex interactions. Fixed.
[*][b]Cleave:[/b] When a character with the Cleave passive got a kill during a turn and died on the same turn (due to Thorn or other reasons) could result in the "next character in the Queue" getting their turn as a "cleave turn" (meaning they wouldn't regenerate MP). Fixed.
[*][b]Selecting Subclass:[/b] Fixing some minor UI issues.
[*][b]Relentless Investigator:[/b] The player could fail to get the achievement if the last chest they opened was located in Gelligh. This fix will be retroactive and grant the achievement to player that should have it upon loading a save file that has all treasures opened.
[*][b]Teleport Other:[/b] There was an extremely rare chance of the AI using this ability to teleport someone "on top of them". Fixed.
[*][b]Ancient Path:[/b] Fixed an issue where the crystal would deactivate after an enemy was revived (until another enemy would be killed), even though it should have stayed activated.
[*][b]Battle Menu:[/b] Fixing an extremely rare case where the battle menu could get 'stuck' if the player hid and showed it rapidly.
[*][b]Displacements:[/b] Fixing a rare issue with "abilities that displace a lot of people at once" sometimes leaving some of the targets "untargetable" until they moved again.
[*][b]Charge:[/b] Fixing an issue when using a charge ability from a water tile, where the attack wouldn't occur after the movement was done.
[*][b]Charge:[/b] When the player used a charge, the target would not get to counter it, even if they had a valid counter. Fixed.
[*][b]Leap:[/b] Leap will now correctly check for traps after the caster lands.
[*][b]One for All:[/b] One for All would ignore the target height and just check for distance. Fixed.
[*][b]Infused Edge:[/b] No exp would be granted to the caster if the spell part of the attack missed. Fixed.
[*][b]Doppelganger:[/b] Some bosses with multiple parts wouldn't have their parts correctly flagged as not being valid for Doppelganger and the player could attempt to copy some invalid ability sets. Fixed.
[*][b]Enemies:[/b] Fixing some issues in enemies generation tables that would prevent a few passives to be generated on enemies as optional passives.
[*][b]Zzakander Spires:[/b] When using "Elite enemies", the added enemy would spawn in an odd location. Fixed.
[*][b]Mind-Control:[/b] Mind-Controlled enemies with Smart Cast would apply Smart Cast incorrectly. Fixed.
[*][b]Pushing:[/b] Pushing someone out of a water tile with a push ability would result in visual issues and the target possibly surviving with 0Hp.
[*][b]NewGame Plus:[/b] Enemies would still be restricted by story progression in their choice of weapons and accessories, even when using the flag for enemies to have access to all the gear.
[*][b]Units in Water:[/b] Certain abilities that exchange position with a unit could have some inconsistent text positioning for caster drains if the caster started in water. Fixed.
[*][b]Fleeing Enemies:[/b] Fixing a rare case where strange AI behavior could occur when an enemy escaped battle and was under the effect of Protect.
[*][b]Double Cast:[/b] The AI could cast a spell using Blood Magic without enough HP if the first cast got countered and reduced their HP below what was needed for their 2nd spell. Fixed.
[*][b]Monsters:[/b] Some rare monsters had weaker stats in an upper Tier than a lower Tier. Fixed.
[*][b]Credits:[/b] Fixing an issue where some names in the credits didn't show up properly.
[*][b]Adaptive Evasion:[/b] Will now correctly be set to "Evade Regular Attacks" after being attacked by Infused Edge.
[*][b]Summons:[/b] Fixing an issue where mind-controlled summons would have no abilities other than attack for the player to use.
[*][b]Interstitch:[/b] Was ignoring the spell height restriction on the victims. Fixed.
[*][b]Stampede:[/b] Now calculating the amount of tiles walked more accurately (it used to calculate it from the distance between the 2 positions, rather than the steps taken to get there).
[*][b]AI:[/b] Will not attempt to cast Wild Cards on a target immune to all debuffs (or that has all debuffs already).
[*][b]Dispelling:[/b] Will now show 0% for the chance of the buff to be removed if the target has an Evade counter against the Dispel ability used.
[*][b]Scar Tissue:[/b] Will not trigger from fixed damage anymore (since those don't target def nor res).
[*][b]Bows:[/b] Under very specific circumstances, the optimize feature when changing classes could end up equipping a bow and a shield at the same time.
[*][b]Blazing Bolas:[/b] Under very specific circumstances, the target could be flagged as being underwater after the spell, even though they would not be. Fixed.
[/list]

[h1]Modding:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]List All Jobs:[/b] The optional GameOptions.txt option to always show all classes in the class wheel was cleaned up to not show classes from bosses and other special hidden classes.
[*][b]Abilities:[/b] Adding a new abilities.xml field so abilities can use the element of the weapon equipped rather than have a built-in element. Previously, skills with "treated as a regular attack" would automatically have this behavior, but now they will be able to decide with this new field.
[*][b]Monsters:[/b] The game started using Monsters.xml last patch, but the file wasn't generated in the customdata_examples folder. Fixed.
[*][b]Abilities:[/b] Abilities will now correctly use the minrange value when being casted. Before, it would only respect values of 0 or 1. Now any value <= maxrange will work correctly.
[*][b]Abilities:[/b] Adding a new field to abilities (PosStyle) that can be set to "kLine" to force the ability to target only in a line from the caster.
[*][b]Jobs:[/b] Adding "noVicarious" to the job fields. When it's set, a class doesn't gain vicarious AP. This used to be hardcoded.
[*][b]GameOptions.txt:[/b] Adding "Vicarious-extensions" table. You can make special mappings there to have vicarious AP work "cross class" (for example, you can make it so that a specific story class earns vicarious AP from another class).
[*][b]Encounters.txt:[/b] Makings more robust in general in terms of error handling.
[*][b]Encounters.txt:[/b] Adding command to grant spawned units bonus stats, speed, max hp or mp. Those are: stat-hp, stat-mp, stat-atk-, stat-mnd, stat-def, stat-res, stat-spd. Eg: stat-hp:100 will give the unit 100 more max HP.
[*][b]Charges:[/b] Will now use the size field to create a max charge range. Using a very large value for size will essentially behave like before (ie, no real max distance).
[*][b]Abilities:[/b] Adding a new counter called "kOffensiveCounterWithDebuff". It can act with any debuffs and will trigger with the standard "offensive action" conditions. It will use SpellHash for the visuals to use during the counter (and use a generic effect if none is provided).
[*][b]Abilities:[/b] Adding a new counter called "kOffensiveCounterWithBuff". It can act with any buffs and will trigger with the standard "offensive action" conditions. It will use SpellHash for the visuals to use during the counter (and use a generic effect if none is provided).
[*][b]Abilities:[/b] Adding a new counter called "kRandomDebuffPerPower2". It will trigger on standard offensive actions and apply "x" number of debuffs ("x" is the power2 field) to the target and use SpellHash for visuals.
[*][b]Abilities:[/b] Adding a new effect field (AddsNonRemovableEffects3) to abilities with fields called: kfEquipAxe (and one for each weapon name). Those can be used to allow a character to equip said weapon as a passive ability.
[*][b]customdata_examples:[/b] Files will now automatically be refreshed if they are out-of-date rather than needing to be deleted first. We were afraid of deleting changes the user might have made to those files, but I guess making changes to those files wouldn't do anything since they aren't used by the game anyways, so it should be pretty safe. Files in customdata will never be deleted by the game though, just to make sure we don't delete people's mods.
[*][b]Stores.xml:[/b] Adding an XML to control store contents.
[*][b]Encounters.txt:[/b] By default, overrides for Encounters.txt replace the section they are targetting. By using the new command "AdditionMode=true", custom data will "add to the section" rather than replace it. This is useful to make tiny modifications, rather than redo an encounter.
[*][b]Encounters.txt:[/b] Adding new commands for the creation of enemy monsters: portrait, sprite and spriteextra. They allow the unit's portrait and sprites to be changed. "spriteextra" is for added sprites, as some monsters have multiple parts (you can see examples in Monsters.xml).
[*][b]Encounters.txt:[/b] Fixing an issue that prevented the helmet and armor commands to be used for accessories.
[*][b]Encounters.txt:[/b] Adding "weighttarget" command for units generation. Format is: weighttarget:AbilityHash|IncreasedValue|Target (eg: weighttarget:HEAL-A1|50|monster0 which will make that action 50% more attractive than normal).
[*][b]Encounters.txt:[/b] Adding "isaleader" command for units generation. Format is: isaleader:number, where number is going to be the bonus EXP granted for killing the leader.
[*][b]Encounters.txt:[/b] Adding "objective" command for Patrol<number> fields (like: [city01-patrol0]). Format is objective:defeatleader. Currently, that's the only value and it will "win the map" automatically if all leaders are defeated and set the map objective description accordingly.
[*][b]Encounters.txt:[/b] Adding "story-<name>" new command. Format is: story-<name>=x:0, y:0, dir:rd where name is the name of a story character (like kyrie, reiner, etc). This will spawn them on the map on your team.
[*][b]Encounters.txt:[/b] Adding "nozone" new command. Format is nozone=true. It can be used in place of zone0=1,1,1,1 command so there is no zone at all. This will only be useful when spawning story characters, otherwise you'll need a zone to have units in there.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.2.0 - Player AI, more autosaves...
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We're happy to release [b]update 1.2.0 [/b]today. It's probably our biggest update yet and it adds a lot of nifty things! Here are the highlights for the update:

[h1]Highlights:[/h1]
[list][*][b]Player AI:[/b] Player units can now be controlled by the AI. Go to the system options and select "Player AI" and set the AI you want on your combatants. Their setting will be saved and remembered.
[*][b]Autosaves:[/b] Adding autosaves at the very start of battle, so the player won't lose all their work preparing their units if things go sour. The autosave will keep all pre-battle setup, but otherwise start the player right before the battle was triggered.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Lots of UI improvements all around for cleaner and clearer information in menus, in combat, everywhere! More options in menus (sorting, unequipping the whole army, etc.).
[*][b]Controls:[/b] Various updates to mouse and keyboards controls to improve upon them.
[*][b]Balance:[/b] A fair amount of balance tweaks across the board.
[*][b]Bug fixes:[/b] Lots of bug fixes on anything that's been reported by the community and from our testing team.
[*][b]Modding:[/b] Adding the Stores.xml file to the list of moddable files and a lot of improvements to many of the systems.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30514749/13eab9662919a46294da31c4881304d11963d4a5.png[/img]

The patchnotes are too large for a Steam update and will be split into two updates (bug fixes and modders notes will be in a subsequent announcement).

As a note to our other users: 
- the GoG update should come about by the end of the week.
- the Ps4 And Xbox One updates should come about next week (or early the week after).
- the Switch will not be getting this update for now. It will be getting the next update (the update for the release of [i]Missions and Monsters[/i]). This is due to added delays on Nintendo's side, tied to the current Corona virus crisis, and is outside of our control.


[h1]Missions and Monsters Expansion:[/h1]
We're finally fully done with the programming and asset creation for the expansion. Currently, we're busy testing, balancing and tuning for the absolute best experience!

While we don't quite yet have an exact release date, we know it's going to end up being in June rather than late May after all.

We want to release on all platforms at the same time and unfortunately, with the current world situation being what it is, some of our console partners are going to need a lot more time than they used to in order to review the expansion, which is creating this delay.



[h1]Fell Seal Milestones:[/h1]
We passed [b]2000 reviews[/b] this week!
Thanks so much to everyone for the support, it's been truly incredible!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30514749/6ef8e4c08f094215fec0e52a16d684e42b2516e7.png[/img]


[h1]Patch Notes (1/2):[/h1]
[u]05/06/2020 - Version 1.2.0[/u]
[h1]New Features:[/h1]
[list][*][b]Player AI:[/b] Player units can now be controlled by the AI. Go to the system options and select "Player AI" and set the AI you want on your combatants. Their setting will be saved and remembered.
[*][b]Autosaves:[/b] Adding autosaves at the very start of battle, so the player won't lose all their work preparing their units if things go sour. The autosave will keep all pre-battle setup, but otherwise start the player right before the battle was triggered.
[*][b]Enemy Turns:[/b] The player can now press the System Menu button during an enemy turn and as soon as their turn is over, the System menu will open, allowing the player to load/quit/etc.
[*][b]Unequip Everyone:[/b] Adding a button to unequip the whole roster at once from the troops menu equip screen.
[*][b]Turn Completion:[/b] When pressing the "details button" in combat, each unit will display their turn completion amount as a percentage next to their health bar. This should help the player make better decisions when it comes to abilities that delay the turn of units, etc.
[*][b]World Map:[/b] Various updates were made to the controls on the world map to make keyboard only user more at ease (ie. users not using the mouse at all, but just the keyboard).
[*][b]Difficulty Settings:[/b] Adding a new difficulty setting to control if the AI will use drowning mechanics on the player or not.
[*][b]AI:[/b] The AI will now use the map's natural teleport points if it deems it a good idea.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Many different additions to give better information to the player.
[/list]

[h1]Balance:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Gear:[/b] Updating the list of what can be sold and not sold. In general, making more unique gear unsellable and more rare gear sellable.
[*][b]Story Characters:[/b] Some story characters have small static bonus to some stats upon creation. Now those will be stored in a different way so they are kept if the unit has its level reset to 1. This change is not retroactive and will require a new game. Also slightly changing those bonuses for some characters.
[*][b]AI:[/b] Various small improvements to the AI.
[*][b]AI:[/b] There was a chance the AI would cast Dispel 2x in a row on the same target with Double Cast. Fixed.
[*][b]AI:[/b] AI wouldn't always make smart use of Focus and Hallowed buffs. It'll now be smarter.
[*][b]Axes:[/b] Increasing vertical range to 4 (was 2 before).
[*][b]Healing Staff:[/b] No longer triggers Chilling Touch and other such passives.
[*][b]Defensive Hit:[/b] Now counts as a regular attack.
[*][b]Reanimate:[/b] Summoned zombies of tier 2 and 3 will now have "Counter: Poison" rather than "Counter: Critical Rebirth" since summons can't be affected by any Revive or Rebirth abilities.
[*][b]Counter: Thrash:[/b] Increasing damage dealt to 1.2x (from 1x).
[*][b]Chaos Slice:[/b] Increased dmg from 0.85x to 0.9x.
[*][b]Marked:[/b] The class's last ability won't be locked by the story anymore but purchasable like other abilities.
[*][b]Marked:[/b] The character that has access to this story class will now learn a special passive through the story (Penumbral Mastery).
[*][b]Exiled:[/b] The character with access to this class will have access to a bonus passive as well (Stampede).
[*][b]Avenger:[/b] Bonus will now be applied per allies that is currently fallen, or has fallen before in the current battle (and isn't protected against injuries). The net result is that reviving allies won't remove the bonus (unless they have injury protection).
[*][b]Story Battles:[/b] Made a certain NPC assisting in the fight in a certain city map more likely to drink potions if their health gets low.
[*][b]Pektites:[/b] Adding an element to their regular attack.
[*][b]Sleeping Targets:[/b] When the target is asleep, a bonus to accuracy will be given to attacks on the target (25%). The target's evasion was already ignored if it was asleep, so this is mainly a boost to special attacks with a low starting accuracy (like Wild Slam, etc.).
[*][b]AI:[/b] AI won't be as eager to get Hallowed Mind by slapping some nearby allies.
[*][b]Scoundrel:[/b] Increasing slightly the odds of Steal Item, Buffs and Gold.
[*][b]Wrathful Burst/Holy Burst:[/b] Increasing the vertical range to 4 (from 2), to match other Burst abilities.
[*][b]Wood Staff:[/b] Will no longer increase the casting range by 1. Other staves remain unchanged.
[*][b]Thorns:[/b] Increasing damage dealt by Thorns to 30% of damage dealt (was 25%) is reflected. Thorn damage is subject to defense, so it is not as high as that amount.
[*][b]Hellmuzzle:[/b] Increasing attack value slightly.
[*][b]Silver Rapier:[/b] Now grants increased MND, like other Silver weapons.
[*][b]Rapiers:[/b] Increasing their MND bonus a tiny bit. Rapiers now grant a bonus to accuracy as well.
[*][b]Ebony Dagger, Quarreller, Crimson Scythe:[/b] Now have a bonus to MND.
[*][b]Reflectotron:[/b] Lowering MP cost to 4 (from 6).
[*][b]NewGamePlus:[/b] A certain secret character will now remain on the player's roster when starting a NGP, rather than needing to be acquired again.

notes.title: Build 1.1.1 Keyboard QoL Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]New Hotkeys System:[/h1]
Hello everyone!

Build 1.1.1 is a PC only update with one main goal: improving the mouse keyboard experience by adding hotkeys to all main "commands list".
This will allow players to easily make selections with the keyboard alone without needing to move the mouse and help speed things up. Here's what the menus now look like when using mouse and keyboard:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30514749/e7ea2a9dbce372127613c52385bbc7db98e6c0b4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30514749/34f569108258500d2ff4dcc0cb21d8becfebaade.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30514749/8eaa4a2ba4b7e921357369b7602bbd2e7c003655.png[/img]

The short version is that you can press these hotkeys to automatically activate them and that things will remain consistent even as you learn new spells and abilities or use different characters. 


[h1]The Details:[/h1]
The numbers on the side are the default keys assigned to "Hotkey 1 to 12" and can be configured in the regular "key binding" menu to be any key.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30514749/895ae6c59e7947278e29916d2fe5ad4520d5fa75.png[/img]

Each action in a list is bound to a specific hotkey, so that they remain consistent through time.
For example, the "End" command in battle will always be mapped to "Hotkey 6", regardless of which other commands are available.
That way, units with Double Cast, Focused Rage, next to a treasure chest, etc., will still use "Hotkey 6" to quickly end their turn so it remains consistent at all times.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30514749/b93ff0a125b61cbade336ea999feef4d07eae832.png[/img]

The concept is the same for skills and spells, where a specific spell, such as "Water II" for example, will always have the same hotkey assigned to it regardless of which spells a Wizard has learned. So, learning "Fire II" later won't suddenly change the hotkey for "Water II" because now there's a new spell before it in the list.
For example, "Sniper Shot" will always be "hotkey 7" on every character at all times, even if you made a beeline for it and skipped most other skills in the Ranger tree.

The only exception to this is when using Double Cast, Infused Edge, etc. The generated list of available spells will simply use the hotkeys in order, since it's not possible to retain "always the same hotkey" across two different groups of abilities, since they would share hotkeys.

Lastly, please note that when using a gamepad, those hotkeys won't be visible in the lists and nothing is changed from the previous state of things.

Let us know how it goes!

notes.title: Build 1.0.4 - Bug fixes and small QoL updates

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30514749/4ffd165b042da04dfb469ce11b0850dd46f3d3bb.jpg[/img]
[h1]New Build[/h1]
Hello everyone!

We have a small update to the build today. For the most part it's bug fixes from what's been reported on the forums. Thanks to everyone that took the time to let us know about issues they've encountered!

We're also adding the option to exchange the confirm/cancel buttons on the gamepad, Switch button icons for the gamepad icons selection, some optimizations and a few balance tweaks tied to crafting components and Blood Magic. We're also adding a new difficulty option that will make the RNG "friendlier to the player" for those that would like that.

Finally, we updated the packaging for a few assets, which dropped the build size down by ~400MB.


[h1]Dreamhack[/h1]
We came back from Dreamhack a few days ago. Thanks to everyone that visited our booth!
The event was a lot of fun and the feedback great!

Thanks again!


[h1]Change log:[/h1]
[u]06/07/2019 - Version 1.0.4[/u]
[h1]UI:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Confirm/Cancel:[/b] Adding an option to invert the Confirm/Cancel buttons to the options.
[*][b]Loading Maps:[/b] Adding a "Loading..." text when a map is being loaded, to be clearer about it.
[*][b]Menus:[/b] Making menu navigation a little smoother, as some of the slower menus could have a bit of stutter on slower systems.

[/list]

[h1]Balance:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Difficulty:[/b] Changing the -15% to enemy stats difficulty option to -25% to enemy stats.

[*][b]Blood Magic:[/b] Changing conversion rate from 1.5% HP -> 1 MP to 2% HP -> 1 MP.
[*][b]Ending 2:[/b] Now showing a red node on the map when certain conditions are met, to show a specific node could be visited to get more information.

[*][b]Quality Thread:[/b] Adding slightly more drop locations for this crafting component.

[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Gamepads:[/b] When switching gamepads during play, it could happen that the help/options buttons would stop working on the new gamepad.
[*][b]Kawa Event:[/b] A specific event with some kawas could happen twice under specific circumstances. Fixed.
[*][b]Story Characters:[/b] Some story characters could have a weird Counter equipped when joining. Fixed.
[*][b]Typos:[/b] Fixing a few typos in the dialogues.
[*][b]Infernal Depth:[/b] Fixing a lava tile not flagged as lava correctly.
[*][b]Patrol Levels:[/b] Fixing a visual issue where the patrol level range could be shown to be over 99 (even though it would still be capped at 99 in practice).
[*][b]Manual Sorting:[/b] Manually sorting entries in the Troops menu would leave many characters walking in place. Fixed.
[*][b]Life Font:[/b] In some languages, the tooltip wasn't showing the correct information for that passive. Fixed.

[*][b]Changing Appearance:[/b] Going into the "Change Appearance" menu at the guild after dismissing all possible units would crash the game. Fixed.
[*][b]Patented Usage:[/b] When the AI used an item through Patented Usage, it would not decrease the amount of item uses left for the item in question. Fixed.
[*][b]Turn Order:[/b] The turn order bar wouldn't update correctly (until their next turn) when removing Haste or Slow from a unit. Fixed.
[*][b]Pushing Attacks:[/b] There was a rare case where the AI could use a push ability on a target that's immune to displacements, thinking it would be useful. Fixed.
[*][b]AI Weapons:[/b] There was a very rare case where an enemy could have a Bow/Crossbow in their main hand and a gun in their offhand. Fixed.
[*][b]Grandhalls:[/b] During battle dialogues, a certain character could look towards the wrong direction while talking to another character. Fixed.
[*][b]Chilling Touch:[/b] Chilling Touch and similar passives would list a % chance in the prediction box for Sabotage and Teleport Other, even though it won't work. Fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Build 1.0.3 is live! - Bug fixes, QoL, balance updates
notes.notes:

[h1]Build 1.0.3[/h1]
Hello everyone!

We're pushing another update today focusing mainly on [b]fixing all the bugs[/b] that have been found since release, as well as some [b]QoL changes[/b], especially centered around mouse usage. We also have a [b]few balance tweaks[/b], although that wasn't the focus of this patch.

Here are some of the more noticeable changes:
[list]
[*][b]Balance:[/b] Various small changes to make the enemies take less advantage of "drowning" the player.
[*][b]Mouse:[/b] While in the troops menu, the mouse will allow the user to select a new character by clicking on them, even if they aren't in the "select character" phase (mouse over a unit on the camp screen, click the left button to select them).

[*][b]Show Details:[/b] Can now be used by pressing-and-holding the mouse cursor over the bottom right hint.

[*][b]Injuries:[/b] Regular injuries (not permanent injuries) will now show the units 4 stats in red in the menu, unless they have passives that increase those stats.
[/list]

The full list of changes is at the end of this post.


[h1]Shout out![/h1]
We also wanted to give a shout-out to our good friends at Overhype Studios about their newest DLC, [i]Battle Brothers - Warriors of the North[/i], which was released yesterday.

If you haven't checked out [i]Battle Brothers[/i] yet, you should give it a look right here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/365360/Battle_Brothers/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/365360/Battle_Brothers/[/url]


[h1]Change log:[/h1]
[u]05/10/2019 - Version 1.0.3[/u]
[h1]UI:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Mouse:[/b] While in the troops menu, the mouse will allow the user to select a new character by clicking on them, even if they aren't in the "select character" phase (mouse over a unit on the camp screen, click the left button to select them).
[*][b]Mouse Movement:[/b] Reducing the frequency at which the "cursor moved" sound can play on the battle map when moving the battle cursor with the mouse.
[*][b]Show Details:[/b] Can now be used by pressing-and-holding the mouse cursor over the bottom right hint.
[*][b]Self Targetting:[/b] Will now skip the "select unit" phase and directly select the caster to save a superfluous step.

[*][b]Ekidna Falls:[/b] Rakkerjaks on this map will no longer be upgraded to tier2 if the player is high enough level.

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]

[*][b]UI:[/b] Fixing various non-fatal errors tied to rare edge cases when navigating the UI. It probably won't have a noticeable impact on most users, but if something behaved oddly once in a while, it'll be probably be fixed.

[*][b]Maps:[/b] Fixing some drawing ordering issues for some maps.
[*][b]Archafflictor:[/b] The Bzil variant had 3 jump instead of 4. Fixed.
[*][b]Title Screen:[/b] Under specific circumstances, the titlescreen animated image could be shown too zoomed-out/in. This should be fixed.
[*][b]The Gauntlet:[/b] When certain special enemies would die, some of the map tiles would become "walkable", even though they shouldn't have.
[*][b]Thespeiros:[/b] An NPC walking around town could sometimes start walking in places he shouldn't. Fixed.
[*][b]Wild Cards:[/b] The case where Wild Card has a critical miss and applies the opposite effect will now not result in a 'miss' unless the target is immune to the effect (ie, it will refresh the duration if the target has it).
[*][b]Chitin Armor:[/b] A certain treasure was granting the wrong armor (Dendrite Armor) instead of the Chitin Armor. This is fixed, but is not retroactive unfortunately.
[*][b]Bzil Classes:[/b] When learning a Bzil class, there was a chance the popup would remain visible if there was a cutscene happening after the battle. There were other instances where this could happen with popups at the end of combat. All fixed.
[*][b]Descriptions:[/b] Fixing some typos and mistakes in some descriptions.
[*][b]Spell Effects:[/b] After using Plaguestorm or Hippocampos, subsequent spells might be partially misplaced on screen. Fixed.
[/list]


[u]05/12/2019 - Version 1.0.3a[/u]
[h1]Bugfixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Doublecast:[/b] Will not be useable after using a contextual command (like gather, open, climb, etc), unless the passive to that effect is equipped.
